title: Workspace review lifecycle and concurrency
description: Run installed native reviewers through isolated production gateways. Prove exact-commit reports, retained task files and skills, source cleanup, three overlapping reviews and capacity rejection while two live browser smoke tasks retain their runtime slots.

single-review.intent: Complete a real review with no slot, retain its report and completed task files, and remove only its source checkout.

concurrent-reviews.intent: Concurrent reviews respect capacity and preserve runtime-slot ownership.

cancel-review.intent: Cancel an accepted real reviewer, confirm native closure, retain its terminal identity and remove its checkout.

restart-gateway.intent: Restarted review work retains its reservation, frozen skill and final report.

source-write-denied.intent: Native tool history proves an attempted source write failed; the reviewer still completes and retains its static report.

repeat-review.intent: Incremental review preserves prior findings and the exact source head.

cancel-allocation.intent: Cancelled allocation stops its owned process and removes the review checkout.

restart-allocation.intent: Restarted allocation resumes one reviewer and retains its report.

restart-cleanup.intent: Review cleanup survives restart without losing the session or report.

restart-launch.intent: Review launch recovery retains one accepted session and its completed report.

node-authority.intent: Node recovery preserves review identity and enforces credential revocation.

cancel-launch.intent: Cancelled review launch leaves no reserved process or checkout.

cancel-cleanup.intent: Cancellation during cleanup preserves the completed review report.

blocked-review.intent: Blocked review work retains its reason and releases owned resources.
